Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Shaver
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/22/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 237 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, district attorneys, the Board of Pardons and Paroles and the Department of Corrections by an amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by the bill and penalties imposed.
Jim Hill, Chair
Judiciary
